name: tabs
title: Tabs
description: Layered content sections — line or pill variants, optional icons and count badges, horizontal or vertical, full keyboard navigation.

meta.whenToUse: Organize related content into peer sections the user switches between in place; count badges surface pending items.
meta.whenNotToUse: Sequential multi-step flows (stepper), single-select form input (radio/select), or sections that must be visible at once.
